explainer.title: Your reward, waiting in the street.
explainer.intro: A placement buys a piece of the real world. Members inside it get your offer pushed to the front of their rewards — at the moment they are stood in the place you care about.

paint.title: Paint the ground
paint.copy: Draw straight onto the map — a high street, the park everyone runs in, the blocks around a gym. Then set the days and hours it should run.

walkIn.title: A member walks in
walkIn.copy: When a POWR member is physically inside your squares during those hours, their phone knows. No beacon, no scan, nothing for them to do.

leads.title: Your reward leads
leads.copy: Your offer jumps the queue — straight to the top of their vault, in the hero slot, priced in points they have already earned.

explainer.oneBrand: <lead>One brand per square.</lead> While your campaign holds a square for a time slot, no other brand can book it.
explainer.mapAlt: A map of central London with six squares painted gold, and one square another brand has already booked in red.

featured.title: What's On
featured.intro: The reward featured at the top of the POWR rewards screen. Your brand is outlined — click any free day to ask for a week.

noReward.title: A featured week needs a live reward
noReward.body: The featured card sends members straight to an offer they can claim, so there has to be one live before you can request a slot. <action>Set up a reward</action>.

featured.calendarHint: Click a free day to request that week · dashed bands are requests, not bookings

form.subtitle: The POWR team confirms every slot
form.notePlaceholder: A launch date, a campaign you're running, why this week matters…
form.holdsNothing: Only one reward is featured at a time, so a request holds nothing — we'll confirm it here, and you'll see the week turn solid on the calendar.

toast.loadFailed: Some of this page failed to load — try refreshing
toast.needReward: Add a live reward first — a featured week has to point at something members can claim
toast.pickReward: Pick the reward you want featured
toast.endAfterStart: The end date has to be after the start date
toast.passed: Pick a window that has not already passed
toast.overlap: Part of that window is already booked — pick dates the calendar shows as free
toast.duplicate: You already have a request open on those dates
toast.sendFailed: Could not send that request — please try again
toast.sent: Request sent — the POWR team will confirm or come back to you

placements.title: Placements
placements.intro: Boost one of your rewards for members in a place, at the times that matter.

noReward.title: One thing first — you need a live reward
noReward.body: A placement always boosts a reward you already run. Get one live, then come back and paint its area.

ready.title: Ready when you are
ready.body: Pick a reward, paint the area where it should shine, choose the hours. You can save a draft and come back.

form.subtitle: Build a draft in stages, then send it to POWR for review
form.startBody: Choose the reward you want to put in front of nearby POWR members. You can save this and return before choosing a place.
form.reviewBody: Check the choices below. Submission keeps this campaign off until the POWR team has reviewed it.
form.campaignNameHint: This is private to your team and makes campaigns easier to find later.
form.rewardsLoading: Checking which of your rewards are live…
form.rewardsError: Your rewards failed to load — refresh the page to try again.
form.noRewards: You have no live rewards yet — add one under My Rewards first.
form.whoSeesHint: Match members by the activities they care about.
form.beta: This programme is in beta. Sending your campaign for review never makes it live automatically; the POWR team confirms availability and launch timing first.
